devin-translation:apps.template.customer: Search any account to see usage, plan and open tickets
Build a searchable account explorer showing each customer's plan, recent usage and open support tickets. Add filters to find accounts that need attention.
devin-translation:apps.template.design-s: A living gallery of components, tokens and copyable code from your repo
Build a gallery from the components and tokens in this repository. Show component variants, color and typography tokens and copyable usage examples.
devin-translation:apps.template.incident: Deploys, error rates and open incidents in one live view
Build a live dashboard of recent deploys, error rates and open incidents. Show severity, owner and a timeline of updates for each incident.
devin-translation:apps.template.metrics-: Charts of your own metrics from a data warehouse or API

Build a dashboard of our key metrics from a data warehouse or API. Ask me which source and metrics to use before building. Chart trends over time with date filters, and refresh the data on a schedule.
devin-translation:apps.template.project-: A project's progress, owners and blockers from Linear, Jira or GitHub

Build a status page for a project from its issues in Linear, Jira or GitHub. Ask me which tracker and project to use before building. Show progress, owners, blockers and recent changes, and refresh the data on a schedule.
devin-translation:apps.template.review-q: Review eval runs or label examples as a team, then export the results

Build a review queue where teammates go through eval runs or examples one at a time, label each one, leave comments and export the results. Start from a sample run file, then ask me for our real data and swap it in.
